g.title: Vancouver Centennial 100 - city of the century
g.desc: A constructed vector reconstruction of the supplied Vancouver Centennial PNG. Smooth analytic ovals, designed mountain ridges, editable horizontal bands, and separate building silhouettes. Both wordmarks use manually authored glyph geometry. No bitmap tracing, embedded raster, font file, or live text. Frankfurter Normal is a strong visual candidate for the upper wordmark; the lower font is unconfirmed. Exterior is transparent; white inside the 100 is intentional. RGB colour approximations sampled from the supplied reference. This is a new reconstruction, not an authenticated historical vector master.
